column1: # Derived, not recorded: layouts/us.tsv (SDL's built-in map) with the keys xkeyboard-config's
# ru(basic) moves (letters, the number row, punctuation), derived in spec
# 011 T041. A recording under Xvfb with setxkbmap (build-fedora, run 43628739112) gave the US
# table for both layouts, so it was not used; a real recording is asked for (tasks.md, For Jon).
# Dead keys are given as their spacing characters. AltGr rows are the unmodified key, as in us.tsv.
# SDL's default keycode options (SDL_HINT_KEYCODE_OPTIONS "latin_letters") may give Latin
# letters on this layout instead; this table is the layout's own letters.
